title: Fixed stars: catalog parser, types & lookup (src/stars.rs)
description:
## Summary
Implement the fixed-star **catalog data layer** in `src/stars.rs`: a `Star` struct (mirrors C `struct fixed_star`), a parser for `ephe/sefstars.txt` (skipping blank and comment lines — see note below), name/Bayer/sequential-number lookup, and the built-in fallback stars. This is **pure data + lookup**: NO position math, NO calc/backend dependency. The position pipeline lands in the next sub-task.

## Files
- `src/stars.rs` — currently a 1-line empty stub; becomes the full catalog module.
- `src/constants.rs` — add `pub const KM_S_TO_AU_CTY: f64 = 21.095;`.
- `src/lib.rs` — add `pub use stars::{Star, StarCatalog};` to the re-export block.
- `.sutra/rules.toml` — uncomment the three `app-uses-calc-not-backends:stars→{moshier,jpl,sweph}` `[[constraint]]` blocks (≈ lines 186–208).

## Implementation steps
Read `docs/c-ref-fixstar.md` first. Cited sections below are by heading.

1. **`Star` struct** (§"struct fixed_star"). Fields (all already in radians/AU/century after parsing):
   `name: String` (traditional, may be ""), `bayer: String`, `skey: String` (search key; comma-prefixed for Bayer entries), `epoch: f64` (0.0 ICRS / 2000.0 FK5 / 1950.0 FK4), `ra: f64` (rad), `de: f64` (rad), `ramot: f64` (rad/century, already `/cos(de)`), `demot: f64` (rad/century), `radvel: f64` (AU/century), `parall: f64` (rad, ≥0; 0=unknown), `mag: f64` (999.99=none). `#[derive(Clone, Debug)]`.

2. **`fn parse_epoch(s: &str) -> f64`** — mimic C `atof`: `"ICRS"` → 0.0; otherwise parse a leading float (`"2000"`→2000.0, `"1950"`→1950.0); non-numeric → 0.0.

3. **`fn cut_string(line: &str) -> Result<Star, Error>`** — port `fixstar_cut_string` (§"sefstars.txt File Format" → "Unit conversions inside fixstar_cut_string", sweph.c:6211–6306). Split `line` on `,`, trim whitespace around each field. Require ≥14 fields else `Err(Error::FileFormat("data of star '…' incomplete"))`. Field map per the column table (field 0=name, 1=bayer, 2=epoch, 3–5=RA h/m/s, 6–8=Dec d/m/s, 9=RA pm, 10=Dec pm, 11=radvel, 12=parall, 13=mag). Conversions (copy formulas verbatim from the §):
   - `ra = (ra_s/3600.0 + ra_m/60.0 + ra_h) * 15.0` (degrees)
   - dec sign from the RAW field-6 string: if it contains `'-'` → `de = -de_s/3600.0 - de_m/60.0 + de_d` (de_d already negative); else `de = de_s/3600.0 + de_m/60.0 + de_d`
   - `epoch = parse_epoch(field2)`
   - new-file proper motion: `ra_pm = field9 / 10.0 / 3600.0`, `de_pm = field10 / 10.0 / 3600.0` (deg/century)
   - `parall = field12`; `if parall < 0 { parall = -parall }`; `parall /= 1000.0` (→ arcsec)
   - `radvel = field11 * KM_S_TO_AU_CTY` (→ AU/century)
   - parallax→degrees: `if parall > 1.0 { parall = 1.0/parall/3600.0 } else { parall /= 3600.0 }`
   - to radians: `ra *= DEGTORAD; de *= DEGTORAD; ra_pm *= DEGTORAD; de_pm *= DEGTORAD; ra_pm /= de.cos(); parall *= DEGTORAD`
   - `mag = field13.parse()`
   Set `name = field0`, `bayer = field1`, `skey = String::new()` (the loader assigns skey).

4. **`pub struct StarCatalog`**: `bayer_records: Vec<Star>` (sorted by skey), `named_records: Vec<Star>`, `by_bayer: HashMap<String, usize>` (skey → index into bayer_records), `by_name: HashMap<String, usize>` (skey → index into named_records). `n_real()` = bayer_records.len(); `n_named()` = named_records.len(). Add a `StarCatalog::empty()`.
   Rationale for HashMaps (vs C's qsort+bsearch): O(1) lookup, same results. Sequential-number lookup still needs the Bayer half sorted by skey (FP note 7), so bayer_records IS sorted.

5. **`fn parse_catalog(contents: &str) -> StarCatalog`** — port the `load_all_fixed_stars` parse loop (§"Catalog Loading" → "Parsing loop", sweph.c:6348–6393):
   - For each line: **skip if `line.trim().is_empty() || line.trim_start().starts_with('#')`** — this is the blank-line fix (project note 2): ignore blank AND whitespace-only lines silently, more lenient than C which errors. Document this in a comment.
   - `let star = cut_string(line)?;`
   - Named record: if `!star.name.is_empty()` → clone with `skey = star.name.to_lowercase()` with all spaces removed; push to `named_records`; insert into `by_name`.
   - Bayer record with consecutive-dedup: track `last_bayer`; if `star.bayer == last_bayer` skip the Bayer record; else `skey = format!(",{}", star.bayer_no_spaces)`; push to `bayer_records`; `last_bayer = star.bayer`.
   - After the loop: **sort `bayer_records` by `skey`** (Rust `String` ordering = byte/lexicographic = C `strcmp` for ASCII), THEN build `by_bayer` from the sorted order. Build `by_name` during the loop.

6. **`fn format_search_name(input: &str) -> Result<String, Error>`** — port `fixstar_format_search_name` (§"Search Logic" → "Entry normalization", sweph.c:6154–6174): take ≤40 chars, remove ALL spaces, lowercase the part BEFORE the first `,` and leave the part after the `,` unchanged (case-sensitive Bayer). Empty → `Err(Error::FileFormat("star name empty"))`.

7. **`impl StarCatalog { pub fn search(&self, input: &str) -> Result<Star, Error> }`** — port `search_star_in_list` (§"Search Logic" → "Three search modes"):
   - Normalize via `format_search_name`.
   - **Mode 1 (sequential)**: first char is an ASCII digit → parse leading integer `n`; if `n < 1 || n > self.n_real()` → `Err`; return `self.bayer_records[n-1].clone()`.
   - **Wildcard**: ends with `'%'` → strip it, linear-scan `named_records` for a `skey` starting with the prefix; found→return, else `Err`.
   - **Mode 2 (Bayer)**: if normalized contains `','` → take the substring from the first `,` (`",bayer"`); look up in `by_bayer`; found→clone, else `Err("star not found")`.
   - **Mode 3 (named)**: look up the normalized string in `by_name`; found→clone, else `Err`.

8. **`pub fn builtin_star(input: &str) -> Option<Star>`** — port `get_builtin_star` (§"Search Logic" → "Builtin-star fallback", sweph.c:6750–6803). Match on the RAW `input` per the table (8 hardcoded records). For each match, run `cut_string` on the hardcoded record string and return `Some(star)`. Copy the record strings VERBATIM from the §-table (Spica, Revati `,zePsc`, Pushya `,deCnc`, Mula `,laSco`, **SgrA\* with epoch `"2000"`** per FP note 8, GP1958 `1950`, GPol `ICRS`). The `,deCnc` and `,GPol` checks appear twice (Sheoran/Pushya, GalEquTrue/GalEquMula) — both return the same record.

9. **`pub fn load_catalog(ephe_path: Option<&Path>) -> StarCatalog`** — if `ephe_path` is `Some(dir)`, read `dir.join("sefstars.txt")` and `parse_catalog`. On ANY failure (no path, missing file, parse error) return `StarCatalog::empty()` — built-in stars still resolve via `builtin_star`. (A single-dir lookup is sufficient; the project opens ephemeris files this way.)

10. Uncomment the three `stars→…` `forbidden_dep` blocks in `.sutra/rules.toml`. Verify `stars.rs` imports no backend module.

## C reference
`docs/c-ref-fixstar.md` §§ "sefstars.txt File Format", "struct fixed_star", "Catalog Loading", "Search Logic", "Builtin-star fallback"; FP notes 5, 6, 7, 8.

## Golden tests
This sub-task is parser/lookup only. The C internals (`fixstar_cut_string`, `swed.fixed_stars`) are file-static / not linkable, so use **Rust unit tests** (`#[cfg(test)]` in `src/stars.rs`), NOT a `gen_*.c` harness. C-differential validation of the parsed numeric fields happens transitively in the next sub-task (positions through `swe_fixstar2`). Assert:
- `cut_string` conversions for ≥3 hand-checked lines (Sirius `alfCMa,…`, Aldebaran `alfTau,…`, SgrA\*) — compare `ra/de/ramot/demot/parall/radvel/mag` against values computed by hand from the documented formulas (expected to ~1e-12).
- Load the real `../swisseph/ephe/sefstars.txt`: assert `n_real() > 1000` and `n_named() > 1000`.
- Search by name `"Sirius"`, by Bayer `",alfCMa"`, by sequential number (`"1"` returns a Bayer record); a blank line and a `#` line injected into a test string are skipped; `builtin_star("Spica")`, `builtin_star(",SgrA*")`, `builtin_star(",GP1958")`, `builtin_star(",GPol")` return `Some` with epoch 0.0 / 2000.0 / 1950.0 / 0.0 respectively.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test stars` passes.
- `cargo build` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` are clean.
- `.sutra/rules.toml` stars constraints uncommented; `sutra_status` shows no new constraint violations.

## Escape hatch
If parsed numeric values diverge from hand-computed expectations by > 1e-8 after two debugging attempts, STOP and report which fields/lines fail with actual vs expected and what you tried. Escalate to Opus.

messages.text: vidhi-review (wave 54–58): APPROVE WITH NOTES. Catalog parser/lookup is clean — unit conversions hand-checked in unit tests to 1e-12, three search modes + wildcard + sequential + builtin fallback all correct, blank/comment-line leniency documented. Two LOW notes touch this file: (1) `parse_epoch` comment claims "Mimic C atof" but uses strict full-string `.parse::<f64>()` (diverges only on malformed epoch strings, none in sefstars.txt); (2) DRY — see the consolidated review on swisseph-rs/55. No correctness issues.
